Ally and Your Career

We see our people as, well, people - with interests, families, friends, dreams, and causes that are all important to them. Our focus is on the health and safety of our teammates as well as work-life balance and diversity and inclusion. From generous benefits to a variety of employee resource groups, we strive to build paths that encourage employees to stretch themselves professionally. We want to help you grow, develop, and learn new things. You’re constantly evolving, so shouldn’t your opportunities be, too?

Work Schedule: Ally designates roles as (1) fully on-site, (2) hybrid, or (3) fully remote. Hybrid roles are generally expected to be in the office a certain number of days per week as indicated by your manager. Your hiring manager will discuss this role's specific work requirements with you during the hiring process. All work requirements are subject to change at any time based on leader discretion and/or business need.

The Opportunity

As a Physical Security Specialist, you will be responsible for enforcing Ally’s safety and security protocols across assigned facilities. Acting as the primary point of contact for all physical security matters, you will utilize your expertise in threat identification, critical thinking, and incident response to address concerns effectively. You will offer guidance, direction, and training to onsite security personnel and Ally employees, ensuring compliance with security standards. Additionally, you will leverage your in-depth understanding of policies and procedures to proactively identify potential risks and implement effective solutions to protect the organization.

The Work Itself

• Provide leadership, training, and technical guidance to onsite security, corporate workplace, and site leaders.
• Demonstrated capability to learn and develop new techniques to help the team.
• Excellent problem-solving skills with a strong attention to detail.
• Provides second and third level support and analysis data during and after an incident.
• Conduct presentations of analytic findings.
• Maintain safety and security of the associates, visitors, and guests.
• Coordinate with all lines of business on the safety and security of Ally’s employees, visitor’s contractors, and vendors.
• Ensure high profile visitors are processed quickly, communicated to executive protection, and delivered to their destination.
• Propose solutions to assist in reducing/avoid/ service interruptions.
• A strong customer/client focus with ability to manage expectations while providing exceptional customer service.
• Collaborate with representatives from public and private organizations to share security related information or coordinate security response.
• Serve as primary contact for first responders.
• Analyzes signals coming from various tools such as access control, threat and monitoring, video, and real time tracking of incidents that could impact the organization.
• Assist first responder entry and exit during life safety events.
• Conduct audits at facilities to ensure they are consistent with Ally Enterprise Policy.
• Assist the Threat and Preparedness team with onsite task.
• All other duties as assigned.
• Ability to assess information quickly and accurately for credibility, relevance, and importance.
• Working knowledge of Microsoft Office suite, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and SharePoint.

• Must maintain a high degree of confidentiality.

• This position is a in office 5 days a week.

Preferred Qualifications

• Bachelor's Degree in Criminal Justice, Political Science, Security Studies, Emergency Management, Journalism, Communications, or relevant field of study.
• 3+ years of professional experience.
• Ability to establish priorities, multi-task, work independently, and complete objectives in a fast-paced and demanding work environment.
• Must work well within a team environment and be able to provide feedback to others.
• Strong interpersonal, organizational, communication and creative thinking skills
• Ability to interact with personnel at all levels across the organization and to comprehend business imperatives.
• Advanced computer skills and use of Microsoft office.
• Advanced knowledge of access control, video management systems, and visitor management systems.
• Advanced knowledge of security and emergency protocols.
• Assist in the response of emergency incidents.
• Ability to work off-hours, night, weekends, and holidays.
• Ability to travel.

Minimum Qualifications

• 1+ years of experience
• High school Diploma or GED equivalent

Other Compensations: depending on the role for which you are considered, you may be eligible for travel allowances, relocation assistance, a signing bonus and/or equity.

jobs.description: Amazon GuardDuty is a customer-facing threat detection service that is built to protect applications and services running on AWS. The service applies advanced data analytics to high-volume service logs and employs techniques such as machine learning, anomaly detection, and threat intelligence to identify and respond to potential risks at scale. https://aws.amazon.com/guardduty/ The Amazon GuardDuty team is looking for a a highly skilled and innovative senior software engineer to help build the future of the service. You will work closely with applied scientists with Math PhDs, and security researchers to build advanced analytics and machine learning systems at AWS scale. You will have the opportunities to work in the emerging domain of AI Threat Detection, which extends GuardDuty to address the unique and emerging threats targeting AI models and generative AI applications. These include risks such as data poisoning, prompt injection, model exfiltration, and misuse of large language models. By developing detection systems for these evolving attack surfaces, you will help AWS customers adopt AI securely and with confidence. Our mission is to develop massively scalable, globally distributed detection systems that protect AWS customers from evolving threats and strengthen their security and compliance posture. Key job responsibilities - Design, build, and operate large-scale, distributed security detection systems. - Extend GuardDuty’s capabilities into the AI Threat Detection domain by developing detections for emerging threats targeting AI models and generative AI applications. - Collaborate with applied scientists and security researchers to transform research outcomes—such as anomaly detection methods and large language model (LLM)–based approaches—into scalable, production-ready systems. - Drive the full software development lifecycle, including scoping, planning, design, implementation, testing, documentation, deployment, and operational support. - Conduct design and code reviews, providing feedback on architecture, scalability, performance, and integration. - Operate in a highly available, customer-facing environment with on-call responsibilities (typically one week every two months), and contribute to building resilient systems that minimize operational load. - Participate in root cause analysis and long-term improvements to ensure operational excellence and reduce recurring issues. About the team Our team is dedicated to supporting new team members. Our team has a broad mix of experience levels and Amazon tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. Our principal engineers and senior engineers truly enjoy mentoring more junior engineers and engineers from non-traditional backgrounds through one-on-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews. We care about your career growth. We try to assign projects and tasks based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded engineer and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future.

About the Team

The Applied AI Engineering team is responsible for helping developers and enterprises safely and effectively deploy OpenAI technologies in production. We act as trusted technical advisors and thought partners for customers, working side by side with their teams to identify high-value use cases, design practical architectures, and move from prototype to durable deployment.

Cybersecurity is one of the most urgent domains where AI can help. Security teams are under pressure to reason across code, logs, infrastructure, tickets, alerts, and vulnerability data faster than ever. As frontier models become more capable, organizations need deep technical guidance on how to evaluate, validate, and safely deploy AI systems in security-critical workflows.

About the Role

We are looking for a Cybersecurity Applied AI Engineer to partner with customers and help them apply OpenAI models, APIs, Codex, and agentic workflows to real cybersecurity use cases. You will work with CISOs, security executives, application security leaders, SOC teams, security engineering teams, and hands-on practitioners to identify where AI can create measurable security outcomes.

This is a customer-facing technical role for someone who can move fluidly between executive strategy, practitioner-level cyber depth, and hands-on solution design. You will help customers evaluate and deploy workflows such as secure code review, vulnerability triage, threat modeling, remediation, SOC and incident response workflows, detection engineering, cloud security, GRC automation, and security validation.

You will collaborate closely with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product, Engineering, Research, and Security to turn customer needs into safe deployment patterns, reusable field assets, and product feedback. This role is based in our Tokyo office. We offer relocation support to new employees.

In this role, you will:

- Deeply embed with strategic customers as the technical lead for AI-enabled cybersecurity workflows, serving as a trusted partner to both security executives and technical practitioners.

- Lead discovery across AppSec, DevSecOps, vulnerability management, SOC/IR, detection engineering, red team, cloud security, identity, and GRC automation use cases.

- Build and deliver customer-facing demos, prototypes, workshops, proofs of concept, and reference architectures using OpenAI APIs, Codex, agents, scripts, CLIs, GitHub workflows, CI/CD systems, logs, tickets, scanners, and common security tools.

- Scope pilots with clear success criteria, data requirements, workflow integrations, evaluation methods, security constraints, safety boundaries, and human approval points.

- Advise customers on safe implementation patterns, including tool and function calling, structured outputs, retrieval, sandboxing, data handling, guardrails, telemetry, auditability, and approval-gated side effects.

- Translate between CISO-level outcomes and practitioner-level implementation details so each audience understands value, risk, and practical next steps.

- Create reusable field assets such as demo narratives, playbooks, FAQs, objection handling, qualification guides, assessment templates, and competitive positioning.

- Validate, synthesize, and deliver high-signal feedback to Product, Engineering, Research, Security, and GTM teams based on recurring customer requirements, blockers, product gaps, and emerging cyber workflows.

You might thrive in this role if you:

- Have 5+ years of technical consulting, solutions engineering, security architecture, cyber advisory, deployment engineering, professional services, or equivalent customer-facing technical experience.

- Bring strong cybersecurity domain expertise across one or more areas such as application security, cloud security, identity, vulnerability management, secure SDLC, incident response, detection engineering, threat intelligence, red teaming, or security architecture.

- Can communicate credibly with CISOs, CTOs, security executives, engineering leaders, and highly technical security practitioners.

- Have hands-on experience building prototypes or production systems with APIs, Python or JavaScript, agents, scripts, CLIs, GitHub workflows, CI/CD systems, logs, tickets, scanners, or other common security tooling.

- Understand how to design AI workflows with retrieval, structured outputs, tool use, evals, guardrails, telemetry, sandboxing, and human-in-the-loop review.

- Are comfortable scoping pilots from ambiguous customer pain, including success metrics, required data, workflow integrations, evaluation criteria, deployment assumptions, and decision gates.

- Have evidence-first security judgment: you validate findings, separate true positives from noise, document assumptions, and avoid overstating model or security claims.

We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. 우리 팀(프로젝트)을 소개합니다.

Art Department 소개

Art Department는 크래프톤 게임 스튜디오의 아트 프로덕션 전반에 필요한 그래픽 기술과 솔루션을 지원하는 조직입니다. 그래픽 기술과 제작 파이프라인을 기반으로, 게임 개발팀이 빠르고 안정적으로 프로젝트를 시작하고 확장할 수 있도록 지원하며, 크래프톤만의 차별화된 아트 기술 서비스를 제공합니다
Art Dept는 “Scale-up the Creative”와 “AI-first”라는 회사 방향성 아래, 장인정신에 기반한 높은 퀄리티, 데이터 기반 최적화, 그리고 제작 효율화를 핵심 가치로 삼고 있습니다.
조직 구성원은 Advanced 그래픽 기술과 최신 트렌드를 선도하며, 전사 스튜디오를 대상으로 최적화된 제작 가이드라인을 제시하는 기술 파트너로서 역할을 수행합니다. 단순한 툴 지원을 넘어, 제작 과정에서 발생하는 기술적 병목을 선제적으로 해결하고, 스튜디오와의 협업(Co-development)을 통해 최상의 개발 경험을 제공합니다.
Art Department는 경험과 신뢰를 바탕으로 국내외 다양한 스튜디오를 지원하며, 지속적으로 성과를 만들어가고 있습니다. 크래프톤 게임이 높은 그래픽 완성도를 갖추고 성공적으로 시장에 출시될 수 있도록, 함께 성장할 전문가를 기다립니다.

Visual R&D 팀을 소개합니다.

Visual R&D 팀은 KRAFTON Art Department 산하 조직으로, 예술적 창의성(Art)과 기술적 구현(Technology)의 시너지를 극대화하는 역할을 수행합니다.
우리는 게임 개발 과정에서 마주하는 다양한 난제를 해결하고, 크래프톤 산하 글로벌 스튜디오들이 최고의 퀄리티를 효율적으로 구현할 수 있도록 최적화된 솔루션과 제작 환경을 제공합니다.
현재 우리는 인게임 캐릭터 제작의 혁신을 목표로 하는 'VCC(Visual R&D Character Customization)' 프로젝트를 비롯하여, 차세대 그래픽 기술 연구와 개발 프로세스 고도화 업무를 주도하고 있습니다.
우리의 목표는 단순한 R&D를 넘어, 실제 프로젝트에 즉시 적용되어 성과를 낼 수 있는 실용적인 기준을 만드는 것입니다.

The ChatGPT Library team is building the persistence layer that helps people and organizations collaborate with increasingly capable AI systems. The team sits within the Personalization organization and partners closely with product, design, research, model, and infrastructure teams. The ChatGPT Finances team builds experiences that help people connect their financial accounts, understand their financial picture, and ask useful questions about their finances through ChatGPT.

You should care about how quickly users can understand their financial lives, how reliably data moves through the system, and how AI can answer financial questions in a grounded, transparent, and useful way.

jobs.description:
AWS Incident Response (AIR) ensures the high availability of Amazon Web Services by making customer-impacting events shorter and less frequent through incident detection, management, and automated mitigation. Our systems monitor AWS infrastructure in real-time, automatically detect impairments, and orchestrate responses to minimize customer impact across regions and services.

As a Systems Development Engineer on the AIR team, you will lead the response to critical customer-impacting events — triaging impact, identifying root causes, coordinating mitigation actions with service teams, and driving resolution in real-time. Not every event is solved by automation; you will use your technical judgment to assess situations, engage the right teams, and direct mitigation strategies when manual intervention is required. Insights from these events directly inform the automation and tooling you build — creating a continuous improvement loop where each event makes the next one shorter or prevents it entirely.

This role offers a unique combination of systems development and real-time operational leadership, with direct impact on the availability of AWS services used by millions of customers.

Key job responsibilities
• Drive the resolution of large-scale customer-impacting incidents as part of an on-call rotation (including weekends and holidays), leading incident calls and coordinating resolver teams across AWS service organizations
• Design, build, and enhance incident detection, triage, and mitigation automation tools
• Author COEs and event deep-dive documents to identify improvement opportunities; create and lead action items that improve processes, tooling, and automation
• Identify recurring platform issues and own projects that eliminate entire classes of operational problems
• Collaborate with teams globally to expand incident response capabilities across AWS regions and services

A day in the life
A Systems Development Engineer on the AWS Incident Response (AIR) team has full visibility on all AWS services! There are limitless opportunities to learn as you will work with all AWS internal teams and have exposure to AWS products and services.

When on-call, your day may start with large scale event — you join the conference bridge, assess the scope of impact using real-time dashboards, identify impaired services, engage the right teams, and drive mitigation until the event is resolved. After the event, you lead the deep-dive, document findings, and create action items to prevent recurrence.

When off-call, you spend your time building and improving the tools that make incident response faster and more automated. You might be writing code to improve event detection logic, building dashboards that surface the right signals during triage, or working on automation that reduces manual steps during mitigation. You participate in design / code reviews and collaborate with engineers across AIR to drive operational improvements. You also invest time in learning AWS service architectures — understanding how services fail helps you respond faster when they do.

About the team
AWS Incident Response (AIR) is a globally distributed team responsible for leading the large-scale customer-impacting events across AWS. We operate 24/7, providing incident leadership and coordination for events that span multiple services and regions. Our engineers combine hands-on incident leadership with systems development — we build the automation and tooling we use, and every event teaches us how to make the next one shorter or prevent it entirely. The team values operational excellence, continuous learning, and a bias for action. We work closely with service teams, networking, and infrastructure organizations across AWS, giving our engineers broad exposure to how AWS operates under the hood.

jobs.description: At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. Job Description The Legal Counsel, Privacy & Compliance is responsible for providing legal advice and strategic counsel in support of Allstate Canada Group's Privacy and Compliance Programs. This role serves as a subject matter expert on privacy laws, regulatory requirements, consumer protection obligations, information governance, and emerging legal risks impacting the organization. The Legal Counsel, Privacy & Compliance partners closely with Compliance, Privacy, Risk Management, Information Security, Technology, Human Resources, and business leaders to ensure legal obligations are identified, assessed, and effectively incorporated into business processes. The role proactively identifies legal and regulatory developments, advises on privacy and compliance risks, and supports the implementation of programs that strengthen the effectiveness of ACG's regulatory compliance and privacy frameworks. Who is Allstate: Allstate Insurance Company of Canada is a leading home and auto insurer focused on providing its customers prevention and protection products and services for every stage of life. Serving Canadians since 1953, Allstate strives to reassure both customers and employees with its “You’re in Good Hands®” promise and is proud to have been named a Best Employer in Canada for nine consecutive years. Allstate is committed to making a positive difference in the communities in which it operates through partnerships with charitable organizations, employee giving and volunteerism. To learn more, visit www.allstate.ca. For safety tips and advice, visit www.goodhandsadvice.ca. Through our Employee Value Proposition, we have worked hard to develop and nurture a culture where employees feel valued, experience personal growth, have career options and truly enjoy the work they do. Role Designation: Hybrid Benefits to joining Allstate Flexible Work Arrangements Employee discounts (15% on auto and property insurance, plus many other products and services) Good Office program (receive up to 400$ back after purchasing office equipment) Student Loan Payment Matching Program for Government Student loans Comprehensive Retirement Savings Program with employer matched contributions Annual Wellness allowance to support employees with improving health and wellbeing Personal reflection day Tuition Reimbursement Working within the community and giving back! Key Responsibilities: Privacy Legal Advisory Provide legal advice regarding privacy laws, regulations, and industry requirements applicable to ACG operations. Advise on the collection, use, disclosure, retention, transfer, and protection of personal information. Support legal review of privacy impact assessments (PIAs), privacy and AI risk assessments (PAIRs), and new initiatives involving personal information. Assess legal implications of emerging technologies, data analytics, artificial intelligence, and digital transformation initiatives. Advise on cross-border data transfers and data-sharing arrangements. Regulatory Compliance Support Provide legal guidance regarding consumer protection, insurance regulatory requirements, market conduct obligations, and compliance frameworks. Advise business areas and Compliance partners on regulatory developments and legal interpretations impacting operations. Support responses to regulatory inquiries, examinations, and investigations involving privacy or compliance matters. Assist in the development and review of compliance policies, standards, procedures, and governance documentation. Incident Response and Risk Management Provide legal support in the assessment and management of privacy incidents, breaches, and regulatory reporting obligations. Advise on legal privilege considerations during investigations and response activities. Support root cause analysis and remediation planning for compliance and privacy issues. Identify emerging legal and regulatory risks and recommend mitigation strategies. Governance and Program Support Support the ongoing enhancement of ACG's Privacy and Compliance Programs. Provide legal review of privacy notices, consent language, contractual provisions, and customer-facing communications involving personal information. Partner with Privacy, Compliance, Information Security, and Risk Management teams to ensure legal risks are appropriately managed. Contribute to training, awareness, and education initiatives that promote a culture of privacy and compliance. Stakeholder Engagement Collaborate effectively with internal and external legal counsel, business leaders, regulators, and industry associations. Serve as a trusted advisor to senior management on privacy and regulatory compliance matters. Monitor emerging legal trends and regulatory developments and communicate actionable implications to stakeholders. Education Juris Doctor (JD) or Bachelor of Laws (LLB). Member in good standing with a Canadian provincial law society. Privacy-specific certification considered an asset: CIPP/C (Certified Information Privacy Professional – Canada) CIPP/US or CIPP/E CIPM (Certified Information Privacy Manager) AIGP (Artificial Intelligence Governance Professional) Qualifications: 5+ years of legal experience , including significant experience advising on privacy law and regulatory compliance matters. Demonstrated experience interpreting and applying Canadian privacy legislation including: PIPEDA Quebec Law 25 Provincial privacy requirements Consumer protection and insurance regulatory frameworks Experience drafting, reviewing, and negotiating contracts involving personal information and data-sharing arrangements. Experience advising on privacy incidents, breach response, investigations, and regulatory reporting obligations. Experience partnering with Compliance, Risk, Privacy, Information Security, and business stakeholders. Bonus Qualifications: Experience within the insurance, financial services, or highly regulated industries. Experience supporting AI governance, data governance, and emerging technology reviews. Familiarity with OSFI, FCAC, AMF, FSRA, and other Canadian regulatory expectations. Experience supporting Privacy Impact Assessments, AI Risk Assessments, and enterprise governance programs. Knowledge & Skills Strong knowledge of Canadian privacy and data protection laws. Strong legal research, analysis, and risk assessment capabilities. Ability to translate complex legal requirements into practical business solutions. Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills. Strong written and verbal communication abilities. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, highly regulated environment. Sound judgment and demonstrated ability to provide practical, risk-based legal advice. Success Measures Provides timely, pragmatic, and risk-based legal advice. Contributes to strong regulatory compliance outcomes. Supports effective management of privacy and compliance risks. Helps strengthen ACG's privacy culture and governance framework. Enables business innovation while ensuring legal and regulatory obligations are met. Allstate Canada Group has policies and practices that provide workplace accommodations. If you require accommodation, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs. #LI-KA1 Skills Compliance, Data Privacy, Legal Advisory, Legal Education, Privacy Compliance, Privacy Legislation, Property & Casualty Insurance, Regulatory Compliance, Regulatory Law Compensation Expected compensation for this role ranges from $ 110, 000.00 - 160,000.00 annually. Actual salary offered to successful candidates will vary based on their skills and experience. Joining our team isn’t just a job — it’s an opportunity. One that takes your skills and pushes them to the next level. One that encourages you to challenge the status quo. One where you can shape the future of protection while supporting causes that mean the most to you. Joining our team means being part of something bigger – a winning team making a meaningful impact. ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.

THE ROLE:

We are seeking a North America Commercial / Enterprise Sales Leader to accelerate revenue growth and expand market share for AMD client products within Dell's Commercial and Enterprise business. As a key member of the AMD North America Dell account team and field organization, this individual will develop, execute, and own the Commercial / Enterprise sell-through and sell-out strategy across North America.

This role will serve as a key AMD sales leader across Dell, channel partners, customers, and internal AMD stakeholders, building the relationships, programs, and sales motions needed to accelerate demand and drive AMD adoption. The successful candidate will combine strategic account leadership with hands-on execution, influencing Dell sellers and customers while delivering against unit, revenue, and market-share objectives.

Success requires strong sales and business acumen, executive-level relationship management, operational discipline, and the ability to build and lead highly effective virtual teams through influence. This individual will align Dell sellers, AMD field teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to translate strategy into measurable business results.

THE PERSON:

Does this sound like you? We'd love to talk!

• Deep knowledge of the Dell North America organization and ecosystem, with strong relationships across key functions such as Sales, Revenue Operations, and Marketing
• Proven ability to grow revenue and market share through strategic selling, customer influence, and strong business acumen.
• Demonstrated success building and leading high-performing virtual teams through influence, effectively aligning customer sellers, internal sales teams, and cross-functional partners around shared priorities and business outcomes.
• Strong executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to engage credibly across customers, partners, and internal leadership.
• Customer-focused, consultative approach with the ability to understand customer needs and translate technology capabilities into compelling business value.
• Strategic mindset balanced with hands-on execution, accountability, and operational discipline.
• High degree of integrity, judgment, and credibility in building trusted internal and external relationships.

• Serve as the face of AMD for Dell North America Commercial and Enterprise Client, building strategic relationships and leading customer and executive engagements.
• Develop and execute sell-out strategies and account plans to grow revenue and market share across AMD's commercial client portfolio.
• Engage, enable, and influence Dell sales teams to increase AMD consideration and adoption, accelerate revenue growth, and drive market-share gains.
• Build and lead effective virtual teams across Dell sellers, AMD BDEs, and cross-functional stakeholders to execute against shared sales priorities.
• Implement scalable sales and technical support processes to improve execution and customer success.
• Orchestrate AMD, Dell, channel, and technical resources to develop and close strategic customer opportunities.
• Align sales programs, messaging, and enablement initiatives across Dell, AMD, and strategic partners.
• Lead pricing discussions and negotiations with Dell, partners, customers, and internal stakeholders.
• Own forecasting, pipeline management, and Salesforce accuracy, ensuring alignment with AOP targets and business objectives.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

• Proven success in commercial or enterprise technology sales, account management, channel sales, or a comparable customer-facing sales leadership role.
• Strong knowledge of the commercial client market and understanding of CPU, GPU, NPU, and AI PC technologies, products, and customer use cases.
• Significant experience working with Dell and a strong understanding of its Commercial / Enterprise sales organization, routes to market, and partner ecosystem strongly preferred
• Demonstrated success developing and executing sales strategies and programs that drive revenue, market share, and customer adoption.
• Proven ability to influence large, complex organizations and lead virtual, cross-functional teams without direct authority.
• Experience negotiating and closing complex customer and partner opportunities.
• Strong forecasting, pipeline management, account planning, and QBR/EBR leadership experience.
• Practical experience using AI tools to improve sales effectiveness, customer insights, account planning, analysis, or productivity.
• Ability to articulate how AI and AI PCs can improve commercial and enterprise workflows and deliver meaningful customer value.

Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field preferred.

Austin Area, Texas (required)

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic is looking for an Engineering Manager to lead and scale our Data Warehouse & Streaming Infra team. You'll own the data platform that Anthropic runs on: the foundation every team relies on to understand the business, make decisions, and keep our systems safe. Every org is your customer. As data volumes grow rapidly, and more of it arrives as real-time streams across multiple clouds, you'll help your team make that stack faster, more robust, and ready for what's next, and you'll shape the long-term vision for how data flows through one of the fastest-growing companies ever.

This is a high-visibility, high-impact role that calls for both deep technical judgment and strong people skills. You'll partner with leaders across finance, data science, product, engineering, and research to uncover and meet their needs, and you'll grow a small, strong core into a large team. We're looking for someone who is comfortable with ambiguity, energized by both business and technical impact, and cares deeply about people.

Responsibilities

•

Lead, grow, and mentor the Data Warehouse & Streaming Infra team, fostering a culture of ownership, collaboration, engineering excellence, and execution at speed

•

Own Anthropic's data warehousing, streaming, and processing capabilities end-to-end: "wow" user experience, ops, reliability/security/governance/cost, long-term strategic vision

•

Support the team to scale and evolve our data ingestion, event streaming, change data capture, storage, orchestration, compute, query, and reporting systems at pace with business growth

•

Collaborate to define and execute the roadmap for Anthropic's batch and streaming data infrastructure, balancing immediate business needs with durable, scalable design

•

Lead key platform decisions for the streaming backbone, such as managed versus self-operated Kafka, grounded in clear models of throughput, cost, and operational burden

•

Partner closely across Finance, Product, Research, and Engineering to ensure data systems directly support business-critical decisions and company growth

•

Drive hiring for the team — sourcing, evaluating, and closing senior data infrastructure engineers who thrive in high-growth, high-trust environments

•

Establish data quality standards, freshness and delivery SLAs, and operational processes that guide engineers and users through our high-change environment

•

Ensure sound infrastructure investment decisions with clear awareness of cost, capacity, reliability, and long-term maintainability tradeoffs

•

Align the broader Infrastructure org on a common direction for shared platforms, tooling, and best practices across Anthropic's data stack

You may be a good fit if you

•

Have 3+ years of engineering management experience, with a track record of building and leading high-performing data infrastructure teams

•

Are a people-first leader who gives direct feedback, grows engineers' careers, and builds trust with technical and non-technical partners alike, while staying steady and principled as priorities shift, knowing when to move fast and when to do it right

•

Bring deep, hands-on expertise in both batch and streaming data infrastructure, from warehousing, pipelines, and orchestration to event streaming and change data capture, including the fundamentals of distributed log systems such as partitioning, delivery guarantees, and backpressure

•

Have owned systems with significant business or financial impact, and shipped at speed while improving reliability, scalability, security, and cost

•

Excel at hiring — you've built teams from small to large, and have sharp instincts for identifying exceptional talent

Strong candidates may also have experience with

•

Warehouse and batch technologies such as BigQuery, Snowflake, Iceberg, Spark, dbt, or Airflow

•

Streaming and change data capture technologies such as Kafka, Pub/Sub, Flink, or Debezium, ideally including running them at high scale

•

Multi-cloud (GCP, AWS, Azure) or multi-region data platforms, including data-residency requirements

•

Data infrastructure at AI or ML-intensive companies: you've served customer teams that build pipelines for financial/billing data, model training, evaluation, or safety workflows

•

Building and operating observability or monitoring for data systems at scale

•

Working in high-growth environments where data infrastructure had to evolve rapidly to keep pace with the business

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$405,000—$485,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

ABOUT NORTH:

North https://cohere.com/north is Cohere's cutting-edge AI workspace platform, designed to revolutionize the way enterprises utilize AI. It offers a secure and customizable environment, allowing companies to deploy AI while maintaining control over sensitive data. North integrates seamlessly with existing workflows, providing a trusted platform that connects AI agents with workplace tools and applications.

WHY THIS ROLE?

This role offers a unique opportunity to shape how enterprises harness the power of AI in real-world applications. As a bridge between our core North product and our clients’ engineering teams, you’ll be at the forefront of solving complex problems and securely integrating AI into critical sectors such as finance, healthcare, and telecommunications.

We’re looking for Software Engineers with Applied AI experience who can own the design, build, and deployment of agentic workflows powered by Large Language Models (LLMs), from early prototypes to production-grade AI agents, to deliver concrete business value in enterprise workflows. You’ll work closely with customers on real-world business problems, often building first-of-their-kind agent workflows that integrate LLMs with tools, APIs, and data sources. While our pace is startup-fast, the bar is enterprise-high: agents must be reliable, observable, safe, and auditable from day one.

Note: between 20 - 40% travel anticipated.

- Work closely with our enterprise customers to translate high-value, ambiguous business problems into well-framed agentic workflows with clear success criteria and evaluation methodologies

- You're deeply familiar with the LLM stack: frontier models, vector databases, and orchestration frameworks

- You have a proven ability to build robust evaluation frameworks, moving well beyond trial and error, to measure agent accuracy, safety, and latency

- You’re experienced working directly with customers and can lead technical discussions with enterprise stakeholders, translating ambiguous business needs into concrete technical specs

- You have experience owning the full scope of a use case end-to-end

- You thrive in fast-paced and ambiguous environments and can execute well even when priorities are shifting

IT'S A BONUS IF YOU HAVE:

- Experience setting architectural standards for AI and agentic systems across distributed teams

- Experience flexing into unfamiliar technical areas, such as frontend, when the problem calls for it

- Exposure to regulated or sensitive industry environments (finance, healthcare, telecoms)

- Experience with enterprise security, compliance, or auditability requirements for AI systems

Portfolio & Program Management Office (PPMO)

About the Role

Sony Interactive Entertainment is seeking a Director, Program Management to lead the delivery, governance, and strategic execution of critical e-commerce, payments, and monetization initiatives across the PlayStation platform.

This role is responsible for leading a portfolio of large-scale, cross-functional programs that span Product, Engineering, Finance, Tax, Legal, Operations, Customer Experience, and Commercial organizations. The Director will drive alignment across senior leaders, influence strategic investment decisions, and ensure complex initiatives deliver measurable customer and business outcomes.

The ideal candidate combines deep program leadership expertise with strong domain knowledge in digital commerce, payments, subscription businesses, marketplaces, checkout experiences, fraud prevention, taxation, and financial operations. They must be capable of operating at both strategic and execution levels, translating business objectives into scalable delivery plans while ensuring disciplined program execution.

What You'll Do

Strategic Portfolio Leadership

• Lead a portfolio of complex, high-visibility initiatives supporting PlayStation's commerce and monetization ecosystem.
• Partner with executive leaders to define strategic objectives, roadmaps, priorities, success metrics, and investment plans.
• Drive alignment across global organizations and mission groups with competing priorities and dependencies.
• Establish operating models and governance frameworks that enable informed decision-making, accountability, and effective risk management.
• Serve as a strategic partner to senior leadership on portfolio health, execution strategy, organizational readiness, capacity planning, and investment decisions.

Commerce & Payments Transformation

• Lead programs related to digital commerce, checkout modernization, payment processing, payment orchestration, subscriptions, entitlements, taxation, fraud prevention, and financial platform capabilities.
• Partner with Product Management and Engineering leaders to evaluate business opportunities and develop scalable execution strategies.
• Ensure business, operational, regulatory, compliance, and customer experience requirements are incorporated into planning and delivery.
• Drive initiatives that improve conversion, payment success rates, operational efficiency, platform scalability, compliance readiness, and customer satisfaction.
• Guide modernization efforts across the end-to-end commerce ecosystem, including customer acquisition, checkout, payment authorization, fraud controls, subscription lifecycle management, settlement processes, taxation, and post-purchase customer experiences.

Portfolio Execution & Benefits Realization

• Establish and maintain portfolio-level planning, dependency management, reporting, forecasting, and executive communications.
• Identify delivery risks, resource constraints, and execution challenges early and drive mitigation plans.
• Oversee complex cross-organizational dependencies across multiple teams, business units, and external partners.
• Facilitate executive reviews, planning cadences, governance forums, and portfolio decision-making processes.
• Define and track outcome-based KPIs, benefits realization plans, and success metrics that demonstrate measurable business value.

Organizational Leadership

• Build and lead a program management organization focused on execution excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.
• Support the professional development and growth of program managers and senior program leaders.
• Build strong partnerships with senior leaders across Product, Engineering, Finance, Legal, Tax, Operations, and Commercial organizations.
• Drive a culture of accountability, clarity, transparency, operational excellence, and customer focus.
• Influence execution across organizations without direct authority while maintaining strong stakeholder alignment.

Qualifications

Required

• Significant experience leading large-scale technology programs, portfolios, or product delivery organizations.
• Experience leading complex cross-functional programs involving multiple engineering, product, and business organizations.
• Demonstrated success operating within large, matrixed global organizations.
• Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, and organizational influence skills.
• Experience establishing governance models, portfolio management processes, operating rhythms, and executive reporting frameworks.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with a track record of translating ambiguity into actionable plans.
• Experience leading mission-critical platforms, large-scale transactional systems, digital commerce ecosystems, or marketplace businesses serving millions of customers.

Commerce & Payments Experience

Deep experience in one or more of the following areas:

• E-commerce platforms
• Digital payments
• Payment processing and orchestration
• Checkout experiences
• Subscription businesses
• Digital marketplaces
• Billing systems
• Fraud prevention and payments risk management
• Financial operations platforms
• Tax and regulatory compliance

Additional requirements:

• Ability to collaborate effectively with payment providers, commerce platform architects, finance leaders, compliance stakeholders, and senior product leaders.
• Demonstrated expertise in end-to-end digital commerce ecosystems, including revenue flows, customer transactions, payment authorization, fraud controls, taxation, settlements, and subscription lifecycle management.
• Experience leading programs involving payment modernization, commerce transformation, financial platform capabilities, or large-scale customer transaction systems.

Preferred

• Experience within consumer technology, gaming, media, subscription, marketplace, commerce, payments, or fintech environments.
• Knowledge of Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid delivery methodologies.
• PMP, PgMP, SAFe, or related certifications are a plus.

Leadership Expectations

The successful candidate will:

• Operate comfortably at executive and implementation levels.
• Drive alignment across organizations without direct authority.
• Balance strategic thinking with disciplined execution.
• Create clarity in complex and ambiguous environments.
• Build organizational capability and strengthen program management practices.
• Focus teams on customer and business outcomes rather than activity-based metrics.
• Raise risks early and drive accountability through resolution.
• Build trusted partnerships across technical and business functions.
• Influence strategic priorities while ensuring operational excellence in execution.

Additional Information

We recognize that candidates may develop relevant skills and experience through a variety of professional backgrounds and career paths. Applicants who meet many, but not all, of the listed qualifications are encouraged to apply.

Why This Role Matters

PlayStation's commerce ecosystem enables digital transactions across subscriptions, digital content, hardware, services, and platform experiences worldwide. This role will help shape the future of that ecosystem by leading programs that improve customer experiences, accelerate business growth, strengthen platform capabilities, reduce operational complexity, and support Sony Interactive Entertainment's long-term strategic objectives.
